en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Husayn b. Ibrahim b. Natana (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ibrahim b. Hashim narrated to us from his father from al-Rayyan b. al-Salt from Abi’l Hasan `Ali b. Musa al-Rida from his father from his forefathers (as). He said:
The Messenger of Allah (s) said: The Shi`a of `Ali will be triumphant on the Day of Resurrection.
